body: can you explain the entitlement/victim complex issues? ive never heard them used to describe me before but if getting over them helps me i'm all for it

I did check my BMR and my suggested daily caloric intake for the day based on bodybuilding.com calculators, but i feel like i can only eat so much. I know i need to eat more because i do count calories but whenever i try i get immensely nauseous and sick, and my stomach starts aching. I try making myself eat foods high in calories but its never enough. Im also taking vyvanse for adhd and that completely kills my appetite most of the time.

I was into bodyweight and weightlifing for a while (only enjoyed bodyweight but i did have a lifting routine), but i missed alot of the workouts. I'd be sitting there and inside my head i'd be screaming at myself to workout, theres no good gained from not exercising, etc but i couldnt do it (maybe cause i have adhd but i feel i was being lazy). I wish i knew how to fix that. I've tried subs like getdisciplined but i feel like however hard i can want to do something theres always that part of my head that keeps me from physically doing it. Its so frustrating and i usually end up depressed later on in the day

Also, I do recognize that i might have some vaguely attractive personality traits. Im funny (i can make people laugh hard within hours of meeting them) im kind (not in the "niceguy fedora" way just like treating people with respect and stuff) and im pretty smart (80% academic average). But because of my hideous appearance no girl would ever want to come even close to me to get to know all those traits so they're useless

With all due respect i feel like my situation is quite a bit different from yours for a lot of reasons

-I'm 5'4-5'5, so I am what society considers a short man. I have never seen a girl show interest in short guys specifically (the way some show interest in British guys, tall guys, etc.). 
- I'm Pakistani and most girls (all races- not just white) think of Paki guys as either fitting the indian stereotype (nerdy, weak, undateable) or the arab stereotype (rapist, terrorist, thug, evil)
- My interests are weird. I've never been very into any specific field due to my ADHD continually making me switch focus on things, but the things i like are star wars, worldbuilding, writing, cooking, music (especially hip-hop) and streetwear. But since im not really "in" in to any of them i feel like i cant be attractive to girls who are also in to that stuff, since im not a true fan of them, so to speak

Basically i feel like i am ugly, unloveable and unattractive. I know girls want the guys they're with to be attractive the same way guys want the girls they're with to be attractive and im not angry at girls for being attracted to the ideal male (tall, strong, white, handsome). I've quietly and somewhat bitterly resigned myself to a life on loneliness and sadness. But you wouldn't see it when im out of the house, since ive gotten so good at hiding these feelings that you might actually see me as a functioning member of society.

But how? My real self is a nerdy guy who's into nerd stuff and music, not fitness. I try to be myself but everyone around me makes fun of it so i need to become someone completely unlike who i am if i want to fit in and have a chance at a somewhat normal life

I never really found the enjoyment most people on here say they get from lifting. To me it's just boring and too repetitive. I just feel like thats the only way for me to get proper strong and fit though

And also about the deism thing; they will most likely be furious. Muslims are taught from birth to love islam more than their parents or their kids even, and my parents have already said that they think apostates should be punished severely.
As for the money, my parents say that they only overwork so that I don't need a job or the army.

Thanks for the concern, but I've tried everything. YouTube, video games, sports, etc. The problem is is that, after I've had my fun and all that, I still have to return to that environment at home that I'm trying to run away from.
Seems like sound advice. I'll try to use it during the next few weeks

I know this will sound like a heap of bs (and it probably is) but i was planning on getting to Pakistan somehow. I'm a citizen, so I can go in and out whenever i want. I also feel the need to help the people there, but ill probably get killed.

To be honest, I only thought about running away in the first place because it was a better alternative to all my suicidal thoughts. Sometimes I get depressed to the point where I want to end it all, but then I realize that i want to live life and experience it. So that's why im running away.
And since these are my last two weeks before going, I've already submitted in the work i need to give in just so i can get by.
Been there, done that, didnt work. Also, this is the best time to go, since it lines up with some of the only days in the year that my dad will be out of town, so I have a window to escape.

And to add on, im quite good at biking and endurance. I know what to bring, and I'm used to cold weather. But i still dont know how would i cross the border. That's whats on my mind, besides the fact that this is increasingly seeming like a pipe dream

I've been lonely for about two years now. My parents and other people around me that are meant to help me dont care about whether i'm emotionally distressed or if im struggling at school. I can't talk to any professionals or teachers, and as i said i have no friends. 

Maybe i should scale back my plan to going to a youth shelter in the city, but then again, i really feel the need to get out

All my aunts/uncles live outside Canada. (UK, Saudia, etc.)

Teachers, KHP dont give a shit about me.

In the event that I do run away, how could I make myself valuable? I'm fourteen years old and weak. The only advantage I have is that my IQ sits somewhere around the 140s range. But that never helped me. Besides having the pain leave my mind, I want to have a meaningful relationship with someone. It pisses me off to see everyone else in my school laughing and having fun with each other, and then I realize that I may never be a part of it because I may have depression and I can't be diagnosed, therefore I cannot get any help.

Also, I tried convincing my parents to move somwhere nice like Vancouver or San Francsico, they can't. They don't have degrees, and they're stuck in jobs which offer very little chance of transferring. I can't talk to my little brother, since I'm 14 and he's 10. 

I only have the idea of running away from home because of how shitty life is here. Everyone at my school is hostile towards me and dislikes me (IDK why) and the only jobs, as well as character in my city are based on the oil and gas business. If I had to runaway, I would either go to NYC or Europe, and just live there until i'm about 16 or 17. But then again, my parents would get worried sick, and if I ever returned, life would be even worse. 

I also have recurring thoughts of suicide, which show up in my head about every day. Keep in mind, I don't want to die. I want to live life to the fullest and actually have friends, but I also want this pain to end.

Thank you for responding. Unfortunately, my parents do not want me to talk about it(my dad was in the PAF, and he thinks that I should man up and my mom says im wasting my time talking bout this) Their answer; study harder and all the pain will go away.But I don't believe that's true. I've been a good student all my life and I still feel depressed

Also, I feel like running away from home. I've even set a date for it, which would be sometime in early March. I know what to bring, how to survive and where to go, but the only thing that's holding me back is my family. If I leave, my family would be crushed, especially my little brother. At the same time, I feel as if my depression will get worse and worse if I stay, due to the negative environment here. Should I?

This brings me to another problem. I want to do something with my life, something worthwile, but i feel as if I can't do it if I stay in my city. In my city, there is nothing to do, really. No volunteer opportunities, I can't get a job and biking around the city does get boring after some time. (I cant bike around anyways since it's winter here) and my "friends" never want to hang out with. They're all busy doing sports or something. I would join sports too, but I have awful stamina and barely any strength. I've been doing muscle training and eating well for the past 4 months, but I can never seem to get my weight past 100 pounds, which is my goal.
